questions.question: Are you 21 years of age or older?
What is the docket number for the underage alcohol conviction?
Was the case handled by a magisterial district judge or the court of common pleas?
How old were you when the offence occurred?
Have you satisfied every term and condition of the sentence?
If your driving privileges were suspended for this offence, has the suspension been completed?

evidence.name: Proof that the driving-privilege suspension was completed
Pennsylvania State Police criminal history report obtained within 60 days before filing

stops: A licence suspension imposed for the offence has not been completed, which is the condition most often overlooked.
Any other term or condition of the sentence remains unsatisfied.
governedFacts.fees: County filing fees vary and no confirmed statewide schedule exists.
governedFacts.feeWaiver: In forma pauperis relief is available on the statewide forms.
